svg.aria-label: What I built. Custom server rendering: React SSR without a framework: per-request i18n, Redux hydration, XSS-safe state. Real-time matches: Server-authoritative Socket.IO matches, Redis matchmaking, Glicko-2 ratings, server-side result checks. Bluetooth drivers: Five hardware protocol families, ported from csTimer, over Web Bluetooth and native BLE. Native sensor plugins: Swift and Java read the accelerometer and magnetometer. Native detects peaks, TypeScript decides. Offline-first sync: A local database and an IndexedDB mutation queue that replays with backoff and reconciles devices. OAuth 2.0 server: An authorization server with PKCE and token rotation, next to a public REST and WCIF API.
